cases.name: retry-configuration
cases.input: How do I configure transaction retries in the client library?
cases.expected_output: Enable automatic retries with SET SESSION characteristics and backoff via retry_count; see transactions guide.

cases.name: connection-limits
cases.input: What is the maximum number of concurrent connections?
cases.expected_output: The default connection limit is 25 per node; scale with connection pooling.

cases.name: backup-schedule
cases.input: How often are automated backups taken?
cases.expected_output: Automated backups run daily with a 7-day retention window.
